full_prompt_en: A square gothic manga illustration shows a black-haired figure with fine glasses against a dense magenta field of twisting gray branches and hanging fruit. The face and upper torso occupy the center in a direct frontal view. Long jagged bangs fall across the left eye and cheek, while the remaining visible eye looks outward with a cool, composed expression. The skin is near white, shaped by restrained gray shadows around the nose, mouth, jaw, and neck. Thin wire-frame glasses cross the eyes, their delicate circles contrasting with the heavier hair strands. The figure wears a high white collar, dark tie with a small central ornament, and a black jacket drawn with many textured folds. Above the head, pale gray branches intersect and seem to emerge from the hair, spreading across the top and upper corners. Behind them, the background is a saturated raspberry-magenta field overlaid with fine black twig marks and irregular mottling. On the right, a round gray fruit hangs from a thin stem; another similar form is cut by the lower-left edge. Gray leaves and thorny lines fill the right and lower margins, but the pale face remains clearly separated from the crowded pattern. Strong ink lines define the hair, clothing, and branch forks, while stippled and crosshatched tones create paper-like shadow. The magenta has little naturalistic shading and works as a flat chromatic ground behind the near-monochrome figure. Light appears even and graphic, with pale facial planes carrying the brightest value and no visible cast shadows. The overall composition is symmetrical in its central placement yet restless at the edges, balancing an unmoving gaze against tangled branching ornament and a striking limited palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形哥特漫画插画描绘一名戴细框眼镜的黑发人物，身后是密集洋红底面上的灰色扭曲枝条和悬挂果实。面孔与上半身以正面视角占据中央。又长又尖的刘海垂过左眼和脸颊，剩下可见的眼睛冷静地望向画外。皮肤近乎白色，仅在鼻、嘴、下颌和颈部周围以克制灰影塑形。细金属框眼镜横过双眼，精巧圆弧对照厚重发束。人物穿高白领、带小中央饰件的深色领带，以及由许多纹理衣褶描出的黑外套。头顶上方，浅灰枝条交错，看似从头发间伸出，延展至顶部与上方两角。枝条后方是饱和覆盆子洋红色域，上面叠着细黑树枝痕迹与不规则斑驳。右侧，一枚圆灰果实由细茎垂下；另一枚相似形状被左下画边裁切。灰叶与带刺般的线条填满右侧和下方边缘，但浅色面孔仍从繁忙花纹中清楚分离。有力墨线界定头发、衣服和分叉枝条，点描与交叉排线形成纸质阴影。洋红色几乎没有自然主义明暗，而是作为近单色人物后方的平坦彩色底。光线均匀且富图形性，浅色面部色面拥有最高明度，没有可见投影。整体构图中央摆放近乎对称，边缘却不安定，以静止目光平衡纠缠枝饰与醒目的有限调色。
style_prompt_en: The gothic manga treatment combines fine black linework and crosshatched grayscale modeling with one saturated chromatic ground. Near-white focal planes stand against densely patterned charcoal forms, while a deep raspberry-magenta field charges the negative spaces. Long tapered strokes and branching networks create an intricate outer rhythm; a compact central form remains comparatively still and legible. Thin precise circles and small ornamental marks interrupt larger dark areas, adding a controlled sense of unease. Edges are crisp where pale and black meet, but stipple and paper grain soften internal transitions. Lighting is graphic and even, with value contrast doing more than cast shadow to define volume. The overall effect is elegant, dark, and ornamental, with limited color amplifying the carefully drawn texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种哥特漫画处理将细黑线描和交叉排线灰阶塑形同一块饱和色底结合。近白焦点色面衬在密集花纹的炭色形体前，深覆盆子洋红色域则为负空间注入张力。又长又尖的笔线与分枝网络在外围建立繁复节奏；紧凑中央形体相对静止，仍清楚易读。细而精确的圆弧和小装饰记号打断大块暗色，加入受控的不安感。浅色与黑色相接处边缘清晰，点描与纸纹则柔化内部过渡。光线图形化且均匀，明度对比比投影更能界定体积。整体效果优雅、深暗而富装饰性，有限色彩放大细致绘制的肌理。
theme_en: A black-haired figure with glasses before magenta branches and hanging fruit
theme_zh: 戴眼镜的黑发人物立在洋红枝网与悬果前
name: Black Butler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
